scope: offline incremental-information research; no strategy or PnL claim

sources.futures_parent: official Binance Public Data USD-M perpetual monthly 5m trade klines; SHA-verified in FUTURES_FLOW_OI_DATA/manifest.json

basis: perpetual_trade_basis = (Futures 5m-derived interval trade close / contract_multiplier) / Spot interval trade close - 1; not mark/index/premium-index basis
causality: exact UTC decision_time T join; Spot open=T-timeframe, close_time=T-1ms; Futures first_open=T-timeframe, last_close=T-1ms; 12 or 48 complete 5m bars; all inputs known at T assuming archive prices publish promptly; no nearest, bfill, centered windows or future data in features

features.B2: current minus preceding basis in percentage points
features.B3: rank of current basis against strictly preceding 90 complete basis observations (fraction <= current); require 90 prior
features.B4: abs(current basis)-abs(previous basis) in percentage points
features.B5: fraction of preceding 3 basis signs equal current sign; require all 3 prior
features.A: same 14 Spot+Futures OHLCV controls as prior A2: ret1/3/6, range, volatility12, volume_ratio24, trend24 for each market

thresholds: per-symbol/timeframe discovery-only q75/q90 positive basis level, q10 basis level, q75 positive Spot ret1, q90 absolute basis change; no optimization or later update

hypotheses.H1: basis>=positive q75 and Spot ret1>0: signed forward residual vs A positive
hypotheses.H2: basis>=positive q90 and Spot ret1>=positive q75: signed forward residual vs A negative (crowding/exhaustion)
hypotheses.H3: basis<=q10 and basis<0: signed forward residual vs A negative
hypotheses.H4: abs(basis change)>=q90 and abs basis expanding: absolute forward residual vs A positive

targets: Spot close(T-1ms) to future Spot close at T+h bars, signed and absolute percent; MFE=max future highs over bars 1..h vs current close; MAE=min future lows over bars 1..h vs current close. Outcomes never features.
models: per-symbol/timeframe Ridge(alpha=10), discovery-only standardization, same complete rows for A/B/C; A=Spot+Futures price controls, B=five basis features, C=A+B; fit 2024, predict validation and 2026 diagnostic unchanged; primary metric signed forward MSE uplift (A-C)/A; H4 separately absolute MSE uplift
inference: UTC calendar-week block bootstrap 500 resamples seed 20261028 across all symbols; one-sided expected-sign effects; Holm adjustment over 8 H1-H4 x 1h/4h primary tests; overlapping windows and cross-symbol dependence remain; secondary horizons exploratory only

pass.ROBUST: correct validation sign, positive 95% weekly bootstrap lower bound, Holm p<0.05, sufficient N/weeks, >=6/8 symbols and >=3/4 2025 quarters expected sign, all leave-one-symbol-out expected sign, C model uplift>=0.001, residual effect>=0.3pp, raw directional/absolute event hurdle remains >0 after 0.6pp, 2026 4h diagnostic same sign, no integrity or outlier dependence
pass.PROMISING: correct validation sign, sufficient N/weeks and positive corresponding C model uplift, but one or more ROBUST conditions missing
pass.WEAK: correct validation sign but insufficient N/weeks or no positive C model uplift
pass.REJECT: wrong or zero validation effect or integrity failure
pass.overall_yes: at least one ROBUST and corresponding positive model uplift
pass.overall_no: no PROMISING/ROBUST and both primary signed C-vs-A model uplifts <=0

missing_and_integrity: verify immutable source hashes, UTC grids, exact close alignment, duplicate/missing bars, OHLC, normalized basis; no filling; preserve extreme observations; fail on abs(basis)>20% or unexplained discontinuities, report causes before evaluation; exclude rows with missing input from all A/B/C comparisons identically; purge target at every segment end
limitations: 2024-2026 market history already examined in previous research; 2026 4h is contaminated chronological diagnostic, not pristine holdout; trade-close basis is not executable spread, and archive availability is not proven live latency; event cost hurdle is not trading PnL
safety: research files only; no production, PAPER, SQLite, DeepSeek, orders, commit or push
